office: the Department of Immigration and Nationality, at its branch offices

routes.label: at one of the Department's branch offices, by referral of the local administration

note: ACCORD's query response on Eritrean documents (on ecoi.net): every Eritrean over 18 must hold an identity card, issued by the Department of Immigration and Nationality's branch offices; the new card (from June 2014, issued from 2015) costs 100 nakfa. The Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada (2013) gives the card as not expiring, kept for the new card. The time isn't stated.

sources.title: ACCORD (Austrian Centre for Country of Origin and Asylum Research), Anfragebeantwortung zu Eritrea: Ausweis- und Identitätsdokumente, on ecoi.net
sources.said: All Eritreans who are over 18 years of age must be in possession of an identity card. ... Identity cards are issued by the Department of Immigration and Nationality. ... The new cards started to be issued in early 2015. ... The new card costs 100 nakfa (six euros).

sources.title: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada, Eritrea: Identification documents, including national identity cards (2009-August 2013), on ecoi.net
sources.said: Sources also indicate that the ID card does not expire
